name: Ninja (158H2403)

origin.basis: Giant Group was founded in 1972 in Taichung, Taiwan (BikeRadar).

manufacturing.basis: The official store listing does not state the factory.

positioning: Giant's China-market folding road tire with aramid puncture protection.
weight_basis: The official listing gives 244 g without stating the size.

availability.note: Sold by Giant's official Tmall store in mainland China; this China-market model was not checked in other regions.

price_observations.market: Giant official Tmall store (捷安特官方旗舰店)
price_observations.conditions: Tmall list price before discounts ('优惠前') on 2026-11-01; the listing text does not say whether the option is one tire or a pair. Shipping within mainland China. A store coupon showed CNY 117.

caveats: China-market model; global Gavia specifications do not apply.
No independent lab test or owner report found.

image.shown: Giant's product image of the Ninja folding road tire, posted by a Giant dealer.
image.alt: Giant Ninja puncture-resistant folding road tire shown as a full ring

rights.copyright_holder: Giant (product image posted by a dealer)
